verdict.name: CFL bulb or tube light
steps: Get people and pets out of the room and open a window for 5 to 10 minutes
Do not vacuum or sweep; scoop up the glass and powder with stiff paper
Pick up small bits with sticky tape and wipe the spot with a damp paper towel
Seal everything in a glass jar with a lid or a sealable bag and keep it outside
Wash your hands, then take it to a hazardous waste collection point
verdict.hazard: A broken bulb releases mercury vapour. Keep children and pets away.
verdict.drop_off_text: Hand it to your city's special care (household hazardous) waste collection or drop-off centre.
verdict.impact: Collecting CFLs keeps mercury out of soil and water.
